name: BestNotes
short_description: Behavioral health EHR designed for addiction treatment centers, residential facilities, and mental health group practices with comprehensive documentation.
long_description: BestNotes is a behavioral health EHR and practice management platform designed specifically for addiction treatment centers, residential treatment facilities, and mental health group practices. Founded in 2003 in Pocatello, Idaho, BestNotes has built a reputation in the substance abuse and addiction treatment space. The platform offers clinical documentation with treatment planning, scheduling, billing with insurance claims submission, patient portal, and detailed reporting. BestNotes provides specialized features for treatment centers including bed management, group therapy tracking, and ASAM-aligned documentation for addiction treatment. The platform emphasizes comprehensive outcome tracking and compliance reporting important for treatment facilities. BestNotes serves small to large treatment organizations but does not include e-prescribing or integrated telehealth in its core offering. The company positions itself as a specialized solution for the unique workflows of addiction and residential treatment rather than competing with general mental health EHRs.
one_liner: The behavioral health EHR built for addiction treatment and residential facilities.

faqs.q: Is BestNotes good for addiction treatment?
faqs.a: Yes, BestNotes was specifically designed for addiction treatment and substance abuse programs. It includes ASAM-aligned documentation, bed management for residential facilities, and specialized workflows for treatment centers.
BestNotes does not include integrated telehealth in its core platform. Treatment centers may need to use third-party telehealth solutions alongside BestNotes.
Yes, BestNotes supports documentation and reporting for CARF accreditation and Joint Commission standards common in addiction treatment and residential facilities.
